notes.text: English/Albion, displayed seed 1412823318, normal 1v1, enemy AI count1; normal resources200Food/200Wood/100Gold, bootstrap enabled, no simulation shortcuts.
Put four idle villagers on Food from sheep and two idle villagers on Wood.
Approved opening Food4 Sheep/Wood2 plan through visible button. Requested: Build a House near my Town Center, and a Lumber Yard near the trees.
Approved House/Lumber Yard. Enemy Scout visible among villagers; requested own Scout to defend villagers at base.
Send the next five Villagers from my Town Center to gather Food.
Approved next-five Food watcher. Enemy units attacking base and population fell; request Build a Barracks and train six Spearmen to defend my base.
Defense compound timed out. No surviving owned units observed; asked why Scout defense failed and whether recovery is possible with no villagers. No manual gameplay interventions or debug changes.

Recovery question returned Clarify: lacks tactical status, asks whether recovery excludes training/assigning villagers. Scout is absent and no Human command events preceded the misleading player-control blocker. Looking for normal UI task cancellation while match runs.
Scrolled task viewport to reveal Cancel task, clicked it for the future-five Food watcher, then minimized Commander to inspect world.

Opening normal match settings to surrender: zero units, Food23 below Villager cost50, economy cannot restart, enemy has advanced to Imperial. This is the sole manual gameplay intervention; normal task approvals/cancellation are Commander UI controls.
Settings click timed out and menu did not open; no surrender occurred. Enemy army is now visibly at remaining buildings. Letting native attack proceed. No manual Human command enqueued.
Normal Settings→Surrender button clicked after zero units/no income; no debug checkbox or resource/spawn control used.
